user.title: Connect a LumenC3
user.description: Pick the serial port the LumenC3 board is plugged into. Ports already used by other integrations are not listed.

confirm.description:
A device that may be a LumenC3 was found on `{port}`. Set it up?

The port will be opened to check the device; this may reboot the board.

error.cannot_connect: The device didn't answer. Check that the port is free (close any serial monitor) and that the board runs LumenC3 firmware with protocol v2 or newer.

abort.port_in_use: This port is already used by another integration.
abort.not_lumenc3: The device on this port is not a LumenC3 (or its firmware is too old).
